Experience varying levels of force and tension as you interact with your in-game gear and environments. From pulling back an increasingly tight bowstring to hitting the brakes on a speeding car, feel physically connected to your on-screen actions.

Feel physically responsive feedback to your in-game actions with dual actuators which replace traditional rumble motors. In your hands, these dynamic vibrations can simulate the feeling of everything from environments to the recoil of different weapons.

Inspired by Grand Theft Auto VI, these limited-edition DualSense® wireless controllers capture the style and luxury of Vice City. Featuring a shimmering, iridescent finish, textured palm leaf details, and official Grand Theft Auto VI branding, they’re a bold tribute to modern day Vice City.
Personalise your set-up and add more players to the mix with an additional DualSense wireless controller.
See how the inky black shifts into gleaming neon. From dark gloss to pure heat, this colour doesn’t fade. It builds. So make your next play at full volume. Make it HYPERPOP.
From deep gloss to in-your-face energy, this one brings the fun – no filters, no holding back. So remix your next matchup. Make it HYPERPOP.
From deep gloss to a crisp edge – this sleek DualSense® wireless controller plays it cool, with focus. So move with rhythm and stay locked in. Make it HYPERPOP.
Shifting colour from every angle through iridescent shades of green.
Shifting colour from every angle with a chic iridescent finish of pinks and creams.
Shifting colour from every angle with a vivid iridescent finish of blues and purples.
Introduce a touch of class to your play with the sleek Sterling Silver DualSense wireless controller.
Ignite your gaming sessions with the Volcanic Red DualSense wireless controller.
Bring an alluring metallic finish into play with the Cobalt Blue DualSense wireless controller.
Plot a course for astronomical adventures with the DualSense Galactic Purple wireless controller.
Illuminate your PS5 gaming space with the DualSense Starlight Blue wireless controller.
Explore new gaming frontiers with a vivid red design, complete with matching button details.
Ignite your PS5 gaming nights with this sleek controller featuring two subtly different shades of black.
Bring player two into your games with the original two-tone DualSense wireless controller design.
Restyle your set-up with a unique camo design infused with patterns of the iconic PlayStation Shapes.

raw_specs.section: LISA Limited Edition DualSense® Wireless Controller
raw_specs.raw_label: LISA Limited Edition DualSense® Wireless Controller
raw_specs.value: Designed with LISA, this limited-edition DualSense wireless controller brings her unmistakable style into play. Featuring signature stars and personal touches inspired by the artist herself, this is a celebration of a global icon whose creativity continues to inspire.
Celebrate some of the biggest PlayStation games, characters and moments with a limited edition DualSense wireless controller.
Inspired by LISA’s signature style, this limited-edition DualSense wireless controller brings her unmistakable artistry to any gaming setup.

raw_specs.section: Grand Theft Auto VI Black Limited Edition
raw_specs.raw_label: Grand Theft Auto VI Black Limited Edition
raw_specs.value: Capture the energy of Vice City’s iconic nightlife with this limited-edition black DualSense® wireless controller.

raw_specs.section: Grand Theft Auto VI White Limited Edition
raw_specs.raw_label: Grand Theft Auto VI White Limited Edition
raw_specs.value: This limited-edition white DualSense® wireless controller embodies Vice City at daybreak, from its white sands and pastel skies, to all its laid-back glamour.
Get the DualSense® Wireless Controller – Marvel’s Wolverine Adamantium Limited Edition featuring a premium metallic finish and conspicuous see-through claw marks.

raw_specs.section: DualSense® Wireless Controller – Marvel’s Wolverine Battle Yellow Limited Edition
raw_specs.raw_label: DualSense® Wireless Controller – Marvel’s Wolverine Battle Yellow Limited Edition
raw_specs.value: Feel the full brutality of Wolverine’s claw combat through haptic feedback and adaptive triggers with this limited-edition controller featuring furious slashes.
Style. Power. Precision. Make your name and earn the number with the 007 First Light™ limited edition DualSense® wireless controller.

Inspired by Marathon’s bold graphics and industrial surfaces, this limited-edition controller blends clean lines and vivid accents. Its futuristic design is tuned for precision – ready to power every high-stakes run.

Master elemental energy in the world of Teyvat. Showcasing emblems of twin travellers Aether and Lumine, and featuring their trusted companion guide Paimon, this ethereal white, gold, and green palette is adorned with arcane glyphs of a fantasy realm.
Unleash your Spartan Rage with this God of War™ 20th Anniversary limited edition controller, designed to evoke the legendary Ghost of Sparta’s ashen skin and scarlet tattoo.

Dive back into supersized adventures with ASTRO and this limited-edition controller! It’s inspired by the playful design of ASTRO’s trusty Dual Speeder. This limited edition controller is no longer available.

raw_specs.section: Ghost of Yotei™ Gold Limited Edition
raw_specs.raw_label: Ghost of Yotei™ Gold Limited Edition
raw_specs.value: Experience the thrill of Atsu’s journey with this special DualSense wireless controller featuring a dramatic gold brushed design inspired by the game. This limited edition controller is no longer available.

raw_specs.section: Death Stranding™ 2: On the Beach Limited Edition
raw_specs.raw_label: Death Stranding™ 2: On the Beach Limited Edition
raw_specs.value: Keep the supplies moving with the latest piece of hardware for Porters heading out on a new journey in Death Stranding 2: On the Beach.

raw_specs.section: A gaming icon in your hands
raw_specs.raw_label: A gaming icon in your hands
raw_specs.value: Take control with an evolved, two-tone design that combines an iconic, intuitive layout with enhanced sticks and a reimagined light bar.
Responsive vibrations react to your in‑game choices and simulate environmental factors in select PS5 games.
Tap to zoom in and explore each feature

raw_specs.section: Play for longer on more devices
raw_specs.raw_label: Play for longer on more devices
raw_specs.value: Keep your PS5 controllers fully charged and ready to go, whether you're playing on your gaming setup or moving away from the TV with PS Remote Play.
Stay in the game and be ready to face your friends with the DualSense charging station.

Dock up to two DualSense wireless controllers 5 quickly and easily with the charging station's click-in design. Your controllers charge as quickly as when connected to your PS5 console – so you can free up USB ports without sacrificing performance.

raw_specs.section: Raise your game on PC, Mac and mobile devices
raw_specs.raw_label: Raise your game on PC, Mac and mobile devices
raw_specs.value: Connect using a USB Type-C® cable or Bluetooth® technology and easily play on more devices including Windows PC and Mac® computers, and Android and iOS mobile phones and tablets.

raw_specs.section: Raise your game on PC, Mac and mobile devices
raw_specs.raw_label: Raise your game on PC, Mac and mobile devices
raw_specs.value: Elevate PC gaming with advanced features like haptic feedback and adaptive triggers in a range of blockbuster PC titles 8 , and play thousands of controller-supported games, including those streamed from your PS4™ or PS5 console to your PC, Mac 5 or compatible mobile devices via the PS Remote Play App 6 .

raw_specs.section: Raise your game on PC, Mac and mobile devices
raw_specs.raw_label: Raise your game on PC, Mac and mobile devices
raw_specs.value: You can also update the controller's firmware on your Windows PC using the PlayStation Accessories app, downloadable here .

Get an edge in gameplay with remappable buttons, tunable triggers and sticks, changeable stick caps, back buttons, and more. Built with high performance and personalisation in mind, the controller also retains all the immersive features of the DualSense wireless controller.
Put the DualSense wireless controller at the heart of your gaming setup with local multiplayer gaming, and match it with fresh console colour covers or a range of other PlayStation accessories.
Pair your new DualSense wireless controller with a matching PS5 console cover for a vivid set.
PS5 console, console cover and DualSense wireless controller sold separately.
From the best TVs and sound systems for gaming to handy additional extras, create a home gaming set up to the leave the competition in the dust.

Grab player two and discover a world of local multiplayer games for the PlayStation®5 console, including sports, platformers and intense shooters that all take advantage of the DualSense wireless controller's incredible sensory features.
Build your perfect gaming setup with controllers, headsets and other accessories for your PS5™ or PS4™ console.
Introducing the Access controller, a versatile controller kit for PS5, designed to help players with disabilities play more comfortably for longer.

Shop for DualSense wireless controllers in a range of colors, styles, and limited editions, and enjoy free standard delivery with every order, plus many more benefits of shopping direct from PlayStation.
